## **Quick Summary**


Workable has three paid plans, and the price rises with each company size band. At 1 to 20 employees, Standard costs $299 a month billed annually, or $360 monthly. Premier is $599 a month and Enterprise is $719, both requiring annual billing. Standard charges extra for add-ons like video interviews ($109 a month) and texting ($89). Premier bundles them. Most of Workable’s AI agent features run on credits. Each plan includes 3,000 credits, and you buy more in packs.


## **How Workable’s Pricing Works and Where It Falls Short**


Workable’s $299 price only applies to a company of up to 20 people on an annual contract. Grow to 60 people and the same plan costs $669 a month, before any add-ons.


Workable publishes its prices, so you can check your number before talking to sales. The figures below come from Workable’s pricing page, help center and terms, checked in October 2026.


### **Workable’s Plans and Prices**


Workable sells two packages. Recruiting covers the ATS and sourcing tools. HR covers onboarding and time tracking. You can buy one or both.


Every plan includes unlimited users and posting to more than 200 job boards. Self-scheduled interviews and interview kits with scorecards come with every plan too. Workable lists unlimited active jobs as well, subject to fair usage limits that the pricing page doesn’t spell out.

The HR package costs extra and is priced by company size too. The free trial lasts 15 days, needs no credit card and does not include the AI agent.


### **Your Bill Grows With Headcount**


Workable sets your price by company size, and it counts everyone. Its help center says company size includes “everyone (full-time, part-time, and contractors) regardless of employment type or contract.”


Moving from 20 to 21 employees takes Standard from $299 to $419 a month, a 40% increase. Premier and Enterprise rise about 38% at the same step, to $829 and $989.


The step from 21-50 to 51-100 adds about 60% to Standard, from $419 to $669.


Contractors count, so a company with 40 employees and 15 contractors lands in the 51 to 100 band.


Cross into a bigger band mid-contract and Workable charges a prorated amount for the rest of your billing cycle. Its terms also let it verify your company size and upgrade your plan if your number is wrong.

In percentage terms, Standard’s price rises about 2.2 times between 1-20 and 51-100 employees. Texting rises by the same factor, from $89 to $199. Video interviews rise 2.7 times and assessments rise 2.9 times. Standard plus all three add-ons rises about 66% from 21-50 to 51-100 employees, from $806 to $1,336. Premier rises about 48%, from $829 to $1,229.


That is why the cheaper route flips. At 1 to 20 employees, Standard with all three add-ons costs $43 less than Premier. At 21 to 50, it costs $23 less. Cross 50 employees and Premier costs $107 less, but it locks you in for a year.


[Capterra reviewers](https://www.capterra.com/p/130175/Workable/) also rate Workable lowest on value for money. It scores 4.1 out of 5 there, against 4.4 overall.


### **AI Agent Credits Add a Usage-Based Cost**


Three of Workable’s four AI agents use credits. The Job Brief Agent is included. Every paid account starts with 3,000 free credits.


After that, you buy bundles. 5,000 credits cost $600, and 50,000 cost $4,750. That works out to $0.12 a credit at the small end and $0.095 at the large end.

Say the agent screens 500 applicants a month and 100 of them chat. That uses 1,500 credits a month, so the free 3,000 last two months. After that, 1,500 credits cost about $143 to $180 a month, depending on the bundle.


Credits you buy expire after a year and can’t be refunded. Workable’s help center also says the number of credits an action uses can vary, so treat these counts as a guide.


### **Annual Plans Are Hard to Change**


Standard is the only plan you can pay monthly. Monthly billing costs about 20% more at every size in the table, for example $360 against $299 at 1 to 20 employees.


Premier and Enterprise are annual only. They are paid upfront and renew automatically each year.


Workable’s help center calls the annual option “an annual commitment.” Refunds aren’t available for early cancellations or downgrades, so you pay for the full year even if you leave early. You also can’t remove an add-on or drop to a lower plan while your subscription is active.


Sign up for more than you need, and you pay for it until renewal.


Your price can rise at renewal. Workable’s terms cap the increase at 5% on its price list, with 45 days’ notice. The terms also let it adjust your fee for company size or add-ons, so your total bill can rise by more than 5%.


The $299 price is the lowest Workable lists for new customers. Your company’s size and the tools you add push it up from there.


## **How Cercli’s Pricing and Features Provide a Better Alternative**


Cercli’s


[AI-native applicant tracking system](https://www.cercli.com/recruitment/) has no public price list. Every account gets a custom quote, so you need a conversation to see your number. Workable shows its prices up front, which makes it faster to check. What you get for the quote is AI screening in the ATS plan.


### **How Cercli’s Pricing Works**


Cercli uses seat and usage-based pricing. Your quote reflects how many people you have and how many entities and countries you operate in. You agree to your contract term upfront in that quote.


The AI Agents plan covers Orin, Cercli’s sourcing agent. It works alongside your existing ATS or HRIS. Orin searches 900M+ profiles for the role and ranks a shortlist. It also connects directly to Claude. Start a search in either one and pick it up in the other. The criteria and shortlist carry over.


You review the shortlist, then send outreach on LinkedIn and email without leaving Orin. Nothing goes out until you send it.


### **What the ATS Plan Includes**


The ATS plan covers full applicant tracking and pipeline management. It also includes offer generation and Cera, the AI screening agent.


[Cera](https://www.cercli.com/cera/) reviews every application against your criteria and ranks the candidates. You can edit and override its ranking, and your team decides who moves forward. Screening is part of the ATS plan, while Workable’s agent draws on prepaid credits.


You can post a job in one click, and the ATS syncs with LinkedIn, Indeed and your email calendars. You send the offer letter from the candidate profile for e-signature, and the signed offer lands back in the ATS.


Candidates pick their own slot through


[interview scheduling](https://www.cercli.com/recruitment/interview-scheduling/) , so nobody trades emails. Interviewers score candidates with built-in feedback scoring, and reusable interview kits keep every interview consistent.


If you want a price before a call, Workable is the easier start. If you want AI screening and interview scheduling in one plan, Cercli fits.

## **FAQs**


### **How does Workable’s pricing work?**


Workable prices each plan by company size, starting at $299 a month for 1 to 20 employees, billed annually. Premier is $599 and Enterprise is $719 at that size. Prices rise with company size, and Standard add-ons and AI agent credits cost extra.


### **Does Workable have a free plan?**


No. Workable lists no free plan. It offers a 15-day free trial with no credit card required, and the trial doesn’t include the Workable Agent.


### **Can I get a refund if I cancel Workable early?**


No. Refunds aren’t available for early cancellations or downgrades. Workable’s help center calls the annual option “an annual commitment.” You also can’t remove an add-on or drop to a lower plan while your subscription is active.


### **Does Cercli publish its prices?**


Cercli doesn’t publish prices. The ATS plan is a custom quote built on seat and usage-based pricing. The quote reflects your headcount and how many entities and countries you operate in.


### **How does Cera screen candidates?**


Cera reviews every application against the role and ranks the candidates. Each CV is scored, with strengths and concerns laid out for the person reviewing it. Your team decides who moves forward.


### **Does Cercli’s ATS handle offers?**


Yes. You send the offer letter from the candidate profile, and the candidate signs it electronically. The signed offer and its status land back in the ATS. Offer generation and e-signature are part of the ATS plan, and


[offer management](https://www.cercli.com/recruitment/offer-management/) covers the process.
